zari-mesic-naboru-2026.title: Come any time in September
zari-mesic-naboru-2026.place: BUDO CLUB, Tyršova street, Mariánské Lázně
zari-mesic-naboru-2026.lead: We welcome newcomers all September long. There is no single date to wait for and no need to sign up in advance – come to any training that suits you and start right away.
bullets: Just sweatpants and a long-sleeved t-shirt, we train barefoot
For children (from about 8), teenagers and adults

aikido-cup-open-2026.title: Aikido Cup Open
aikido-cup-open-2026.lead: We invite members of Aikido Mariánské Lázně, their families and friends to the first edition of our nine-pin bowling tournament. This time a lane instead of the tatami, and pins instead of uke.
bullets: Entry fee CZK 100 + bring one prize
Sportswear and clean shoes with white soles
Refreshments during the tournament by Pizzerie Kuželna
aikido-cup-open-2026.imageAlt: Aikido Cup Open poster – an aikidoka in hakama bowling

seminar-wasserbauer-2026.title: Aikido seminar with Richard Wasserbauer
seminar-wasserbauer-2026.place: Budo club, Tyršova street, Mariánské Lázně
seminar-wasserbauer-2026.lead: Together with the Aikido pro každého club we invite you to a weekend seminar led by Richard Wasserbauer, 5th dan Aikikai. Come for the whole seminar or just a single class.
bullets: Whole seminar CZK 500, single class CZK 250
Bring your weapons! Sleeping on the tatami possible
seminar-wasserbauer-2026.imageAlt: Poster: Aikido seminar led by Richard Wasserbauer, 5th dan Aikikai
